appraisal_events.evidence: « C'est entendu, je réponds pour elle, j'en fais mon affaire. » — « Robert, comme je vous aime ! »
appraisal_events.explanation: Saint-Loup readily and generously agrees to intercede with his aunt on the narrator's behalf, prompting an open, unguarded declaration of affection from the narrator; Saint-Loup then gently reminds him of his unfulfilled promise to use «tu», reinforcing the closeness rather than undercutting it.

status_effects.explanation: Saint-Loup comes off warmly in this exchange, shown as generous and quick to use his own credit with his aunt to help the narrator, which earns him explicit admiration.
The narrator gains ground emotionally, securing both practical help (access to the painting via Saint-Loup's aunt) and confirmation of a warm, intimate friendship.
